item.summary: fix(agents): quiet model turns are aborted by a false "no response from model" idle timeout (#117884) * fix(agents): quiet model turns are aborted by a false "no response from model" idle timeout The embedded runner merges the caller's request signal with the run's cancellation signal through AbortSignal.any, which produces a new signal object. The LLM request-activity registry is keyed by signal identity, so transports that report progress with notifyLlmRequestActivity(options.signal) now notify the composite while the idle watchdog is still listening on the signal it handed in. Every keep-alive is dropped, and turns whose only sign of life is that keep-alive (hidden reasoning on openai-completions, buffered Claude refusals) are aborted as idle while the model is still responding. Bridge activity from the composite back to the caller signal at mergeRunSignal, the single site that holds both, restoring the pre-merge identity for the activity channel while keeping both cancellation owners. The bridge is disposed from the caller signal rather than the composite: Node keeps composite signals that carry an abort listener in a process-wide strong set until the last listener is removed.
